name: onebox
description: Ship iOS apps from one cheap box. Skills for Expo apps, App Store Connect, content and a self-hosted backend on a mini PC or a small VPS.

plugins.name: ship-ios
plugins.description: Take an Expo iOS app from 'works on my phone' to TestFlight and the App Store: readiness checks, local builds, preview builds, App Store Connect, screenshots and icons. Runs on your Mac.

plugins.name: content
plugins.description: Turn reels and videos into text an LLM can use, and generate images with kie.ai. Runs on your Mac.

plugins.name: box
plugins.description: Run your backend and sites on one cheap box: a mini PC at home or a small VPS, with Docker, Traefik and Cloudflare Tunnel.
